_bob.plan: W5t, docs/COMFYUI.md track C, pipeline step 2 (primary geometry graph)
_bob.purpose: A subject image with alpha to a dense, UV-unwrapped mesh. Open surfaces included, which is the whole reason TRELLIS.2 is primary.
deviations_from_source: MaskPreview and GeomPackPreviewMeshVTK dropped: they are GUI viewers, and Bob fetches the result over /view.

Trellis2ExportTrimesh plus Preview3D added. The export node is the one that writes a GLB with the Z-up to Y-up conversion and the UV V-flip glTF needs, but it reports its path only as a STRING output, which never reaches the job's outputs dict. Preview3D takes that string and emits a proper {filename, subfolder, type} entry, which is how Bob learns the server-side name it then fetches.

BOB_* titles added on the templated nodes. BOB_MODEL binds the resolution tier (512 preview / 1024 default / 1536_cascade hero) rather than a model filename: LoadTrellis2Models takes no checkpoint name.
target_face_count stays at the source's 500000, because the simplify budget is Bob's decision at import and a second, earlier budget here would just be a number to keep in sync.
_bob.notes: The alpha of BOB_IMAGE is what makes this work. LoadImage returns mask = 1 - alpha, InvertMask puts it back, and Trellis2GetConditioning takes the foreground. An opaque PNG therefore conditions on the whole square frame. Measured at G0.5: 1024 warm is about 87 s and peaks at 5.7 GB of 16, so no cascade is needed at 1024.
